_comment: Fail-closed ratchet for the SILENT tactic-failure class (RC-Q / brick T0 of docs/plans/TACTICS_TO_100_2026-07-29.md). `silent` = the probe declaration failed with NO diagnostic anywhere naming the construct, so the user sees only `declaration uses synthetic sorry`. That class is unactionable AND unmeasurable: every UnknownTactic-keyed coverage script in the repo under-reports by exactly this much. baseline_silent is 0 and MUST STAY 0 - do not raise it to land a tactic. Regenerate the census with CLEAN_SILENT_CENSUS_UPDATE=1 cargo test --offline --release -p clean-elab --test silent_tactic_census, then ratchet down with scripts/check_silent_tactic_ratchet.py --update.

measured_on_origin_main_2026_08_07.note: 27 of 374 probes over 288 tactic tokens produced zero diagnostics. Silent tokens were: cases (| _ =>), clear, conv (in / tactic =>), conv_lhs, conv_rhs, guard_target, let', letI, module, on_goal, rcases (- pattern), rename_i, revert, rw, set, set!, specialize, subst, conv-mode tactic, conv-mode tactic', unfold, and the ELIMINATOR notation. sorry/admit are intentional and excluded.
